node.statement: The (i,j) entry of Z^dagger is Z_{ji}^dagger, which lies in S_{R,P} by node 1.2.1. Hence the (i,j) block of (Ha^Q_{R,P})_n(Z^dagger) is Ha^Q_{R,P}(Z_{ji}^dagger). Node 1.3 identifies this with Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_{ji})^dagger, the (i,j) block found in node 1.4.1. Equality of every block proves the amplified operator equality, and arbitrary n,Z plus node 1.1 gives the universal assertion.
